summary: The revision-.8 proposed universal conditional 3-D spectral projection cap is false even for an exact target-class product source: for iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2], Y1=(X1+X2)/sqrt(2), Z=(X1-X2)/sqrt(2), Y2=X3, Y3=X4, and Q=Y1^2+Y2^2+Y3^2 with spectrum {1,1,1,0}, the conditional density cap is 1/(sqrt(2)-2|z|) and has infinite essential supremum in z, while Q itself has density <=pi. Separately, a cap-one unit-volume spherical shell in R^3 gives the identity quadratic pushforward density 2*pi*sqrt(s), so no rank-three coarea bound can depend only on ||rho||_infinity for arbitrary 3-D rho. These refute only the intermediate route, not QFORM. A valid repair must retain stronger product/projection structure and avoid taking the damaging conditional supremum before curved averaging.
